title: Real
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Three young men in Japan meet through wheelchair basketball: Togawa, a former sprinter who lost a leg to bone cancer; Nomiya, a dropout carrying guilt for a crash that paralyzed a girl; and Takahashi, a popular team captain paralyzed in an accident. The series follows their slow, uneven efforts to accept what has happened and find a place to compete.
life_message: It holds up facing reality honestly, taking responsibility for one's choices, and finding worth through effort and belonging rather than status.

content.note: Fights among delinquents and teammates and serious accidents; not described as graphic (to verify).
Amputation, paralysis and the aftermath of a crash are shown with realism.
Some sexual references among young adults (to verify).
Rough, everyday profanity typical of a seinen sports drama (to verify).
Adult drinking and smoking may appear (to verify).
Despair, inferiority and bullying after disability are central (Wikipedia, AniList, MangaUpdates).
Reckless behavior leads to a life-changing crash; consequences are shown.
